name: Jet Jammer - Armor
RelatedDescription: This jetpack enables an ST to fly over short distances, quickly traversing obstacles to reach even the most inaccessible corners of the battlefield. Also integrates a function that affects the enemy's Armor capability.

61217.name: Flying Device I · Armor
61217.SpecificEffects:
ST Move Method changes to levitation, enabling ST to pass over low obstacles.
In combat, the enemy's Armor <color=#F74848>-50%</color>.
ST Body's HP <color=#F74848>+10%</color>, DMG Dealt <color=#F74848>+5%</color>.
